name: Aspire11
decision_note: Prague-based private-markets platform (founded 2025 by Pavel Mucha with the Partners group) investing EUR 500m+ of Czech pension capital directly into growth-stage tech companies (Eternals, e.g. EUR 20m into Vinted in June 2026) and into VC funds (Tribes).

funds.name: Aspire 11 Capital SICAV, a.s. (inaugural fund, Rentea commitment)

evidence.quote: Aspire11 se zaměřuje na produktové firmy v kategoriích s vysokou produktivitou (zemědělství, strojírenství, automotive, logistika, IT, hi-tech).
peníze nasměruje v podobě přímých vstupů do pokročilých růstových kol do globálně významných scale-upů
Investiční platforma Aspire11 představila strategii alokace 500 milionů eur (12,5 miliardy korun) z českého penzijního kapitálu do evropských a globálních technologických firem.
Aspire11 has deployed the first €100 million from its €515 million fund
The platform was launched in September 2025, with €500 million fully committed by Czech pension company Rentea
jde o přímou investici ve výši 20 milionů eur, tedy v přepočtu skoro půl miliardy korun
The first portfolio includes companies such as Revolut, ElevenLabs, Databricks, Vinted, VAST Data and Baseten.

analyst_notes: Classification: dual strategy - Eternals (about 80% of capital per the Partners leaflet; EUR 300m per Lupa 2025-10-24) makes direct minority investments in growth-stage private tech companies; Tribes (EUR 100m) commits to 15-20 VC funds (fund-of-funds part, which alone would be E5). Because the dominant activity is direct growth-stage minority equity in VC-backed companies, the record is typed vc with stage growth; a reviewer could argue pe (large growth minority) - flagged. Ticket EUR 10-30m is the Eternals target investment per the Partners leaflet (undated 2025 marketing leaflet of the Partners group, which co-founded Aspire11; treated as B). Sector focus is the leaflet's stated list; the actual Eternals portfolio is mostly AI/data, fintech and e-commerce (Revolut, ElevenLabs, Databricks, Vinted, VAST Data, Baseten). Capital: Recursive 2026-07-15 says EUR 515m fund (EUR 500m committed by Rentea at launch in September 2025; month-only date recorded as 2025-09-01). Vinted: EUR 20m is Aspire11's own direct investment (round size not given), so round_amount is left empty; the Lupa item is authored by Aspire11 (press release), hence class B. Dates of Revolut/ElevenLabs/Databricks investments are not disclosed (in portfolio by 2026-07-15). Legal: Aspire 11 Capital SICAV is managed by Partners investiční společnost, a.s. (statutory body per ARES); Aspire 11 Capital Partners and Aspire 11 Advisers are Pavel Mucha's companies (roles not confirmed, recorded as other). The feeder 'Aspire 11 fond fondů 25' (IČO 75166020, Partners IS) is a distribution vehicle and not listed as a fund of the investor. No own website found (aspire11.com is an unrelated US apartment site).
